entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-14
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Yarp need to be configured explicitly for @react-refresh #63258
  • Update to .NET 11 #63257
    .NET 11 Planning
  • Bug: JsonPolymorphic fails with case-insensitive discriminator property name #63253

Closed

  • Empty OpenApi schema is generated for type referenced multiple times as generic argument #61194
    10.0-rc1
  • [FromForm] Complex objects with MinimalApi and AOT #61382
  • Robinhood #63259
  • Blazor Wasm performance regression #63148
    10.0-rc2
  • Wrong Http Headers on responses #60338
    10.0-rc1
  • Unable to transmit a large byte array from the server to the client in Blazor #63206
  • [Blazor] `AddServerSideblazor` fails without `AddRazorPages` #53587
    Backlog
  • [Blazor] Generate better error message(s) when we encounter an unknown RenderTreeFrameType #63229
    10.0-rc1
  • [Blazor] Implement property analyzer also for [PersistentState] #63235
  • IBrowserFile Binding Converter Error #56832
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Add HttpMethods.Query constant and IsQuery method to ASP.NET Core #63260
  • Fixed the ErrorBoundary multiple errors bug #63254
    area-blazor

Merged

  • Resolve relative JSON schema references in root schema #63256
    feature-openapi, area-minimal, 10.0-rc1
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #63255
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, build-ops, 10.0-rc1
  • [Blazor] Generate better error message(s) when we encounter an unknown RenderTreeFrameType #63230
    Attention: Shared Code Modified, 10.0-rc1
  • [Blazor] Implement property analyzer for [PersistentState] attribute #63236
    Attention: Shared Code Modified, 10.0-rc1
  • [Blazor] Always treat "preloads" as new elements when doing enhanced navigation #63239
    area-blazor, 10.0-rc1
  • Fix IBrowserFile Name property to return FileName instead of form field name #63238
    Attention: Shared Code Modified, 10.0-rc1

Updated

  • Make new validations consistent with System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations behavior #63231
    area-blazor, area-minimal, feature-validation
  • Fix Blazor persistent component state restoration for components without keys and add E2E test coverage #63194
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • Send Keep-Alive Ping Immediately When Previous Ping Is Overdue #63195
    area-signalr, community-contribution
  • Add PQC certificate support for HTTPS #62866
    area-networking
  • Add analyzer and codefixer for WebHost.CreateDefaultBuilder to Host.CreateDefaultBuilder.ConfigureWebHostDefaults #63246
    area-minimal
  • Add [Obsolete] attribute to WebHost class and IWebHost interface with proper diagnostic codes, convert sample apps to HostBuilder pattern #63024
  • Add exception on failed port string parsing in BindingAddress.cs Resolves #24384 #63135
    community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun, area-networking, 10.0-rc1
  • [WIP] Update to wix5 #62885
    area-infrastructure
  • Deoptimize the exceptional cases in favor of optimal path #62997
    area-blazor, 10.0-rc1
  • [Blazor] Add analyzer to detect ElementReference usage outside OnAfterRender with helper method analysis #63248
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • Improve logging and error handling for IIS ASP.NET Core module shadow copy #63000
    community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun, area-networking
  • Docs: Add instructions for viewing build-time OpenAPI logs with Terminal Logger #63251
    area-commandlinetools, community-contribution, feature-openapi
  • Enable `E2ETest.ServerExecutionTests.CircuitTests` #63143
    area-blazor, pending-ci-rerun, 10.0-rc1
